# PickleShell

> Give ChatGPT a local machine to work with.

PickleShell connects ChatGPT Assistant to an OpenCode agent running on a user's
machine. ChatGPT can send instructions and small files, follow execution,
read results, and continue work in the same session. The agent runs inside a
selected workspace through an outbound-only Secure MCP Tunnel.

PickleShell removes the manual relay between ChatGPT and a local coding agent:
ChatGPT keeps the architectural context, OpenCode works with the repository,
and the user remains the owner and observer.
